items.reason: A morning vitamin C serum suits your wish for a brighter, more even-looking tone.
A tinted mineral SPF with iron oxides is a daily step that helps keep dark patches looking even, and it suits deeper skin tones.

response.routine_note: A mole that has grown and darkened this year is best checked by a dermatologist soon, so we have not added anything for it and suggest keeping products off that spot until you have been seen. Apply the vitamin C serum to clean skin each morning, then finish with the tinted SPF.
